name: ESF Summer Camps at Devon Preparatory School
description_short: ESF day camp on the Devon Preparatory School campus in Devon for boys and girls from rising preschool to grade 10. Campers are grouped by grade, swim with Red Cross certified lifeguards and instructors, and pick from more than 60 activities across sports, arts, science, engineering and technology.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel by March 15, 2027 for a refund less the $50 registration fee (a full cancellation also costs $300 per child); from March 16 to June 1, 2027, a credit instead of a refund; no refunds or credits after June 1. An optional protection plan covers injury or illness.
notes: Standard 2027 rates for the main day camp (rising PreS to 8th): 2 weeks $1,530 up to 9 weeks $6,615; early bird rates until February 1, 2027 are $100 to $450 less (2 weeks $1,430). 5+ weeks save $30 a week. Specialty STEAM camps (rising K to 4) $765 a week standard. Young Leaders Program (rising 9 and 10) $1,540 for 4 weeks. Weeks need not be consecutive. Standard hours 9:00 to 3:00. Club OT extended day until 5:00 is included in tuition; 5:00 to 5:30 costs extra. Optional lunch program at extra cost. No camp Friday June 18 or Monday July 5, 2027; those weeks are priced lower. Sibling discount $20.
